insurer: Government of India (implemented through empanelled public and private insurance companies)
what_it_does: Government-backed crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases, helping to stabilize farm income.

premium.note: These are the maximum premium shares payable by farmers; the balance actuarial premium is subsidized by Central and State governments.

government_subsidy: Typically 90–98% of the actuarial premium is borne by the Central and State governments, depending on the crop and state.
coverage: Yield loss due to widespread natural calamities such as drought, flood, cyclone, hailstorm, and other notified events
Loss due to pests and crop diseases for notified crops
Prevented sowing or planting in notified areas due to adverse weather conditions
Post-harvest losses for specified crops caused by unseasonal rain or cyclones for a limited period after harvest, as per scheme rules
Localised calamities such as hailstorm, landslide, and inundation affecting individual farms, where notified
exclusions: Losses due to farmer negligence or improper farming practices
Losses to crops not notified under the scheme by the state
Post-harvest losses occurring beyond the notified coverage period
Non-compliance with scheme guidelines or false claims

notified_crops_and_area_basis.notified_crops: Food crops (cereals, millets, pulses), oilseeds, annual commercial crops, and annual horticultural crops as notified by the respective state government.
notified_crops_and_area_basis.area_approach: Implemented on an 'area approach' basis where yield loss is assessed for a defined notified unit area, and all insured farmers in that unit receive compensation based on the same threshold yield.

claim_and_payout_notes.sum_insured_basis: Sum insured is generally linked to the scale of finance, loan amount, or cost of cultivation for the insured crop.
claim_and_payout_notes.payout_trigger: Claims are paid if the actual yield in the notified area falls below the threshold yield fixed for that crop and area.
claim_and_payout_notes.timeline_goal: The scheme aims to settle claims within approximately 2 months after final yield data is received, although timelines may vary by state.

best_for: Loanee farmers who take crop loans from banks or cooperative societies
Non-loanee farmers who cultivate notified crops in participating districts
Farmers seeking protection from weather, pest, and yield risks at a very low premium cost

how_farmers_enrol: Automatically through banks or cooperative societies when availing crop loans
Through Common Service Centres (CSC) or the PMFBY online portal in many states
Through authorised insurance company agents or agriculture department offices
required_details: Crop type, season, and cultivated area details
Active bank account details for direct claim credit
KYC documents as per state and insurer requirements

state_variation_note: Coverage details, notified crops, premium subsidy sharing, and claim timelines vary by state and season.

scheme_governance.implemented_by: Government of India in coordination with State Governments and empanelled insurance companies.
key_objectives: Provide affordable and comprehensive crop insurance coverage against natural and biological risks
Stabilize farmers’ income and reduce dependence on ad-hoc disaster relief
Encourage adoption of modern agricultural practices
Improve credit flow to the agriculture sector
